text: Final categorization: REVIEW (Justification: This paper is a review article synthesizing existing quantitative land use scenario studies focusing on future European agricultural landscapes. It compiles and compares 25 scenarios from seven studies, all involving quantitative land use/cover change projections on European and global scales. The paper analyzes scenario designs, driving forces, and outcomes relevant to agricultural land use/cover change. Although it does not present new spatial modeling results, it thoroughly reviews and evaluates multiple quantitative LULC prediction studies, fitting the criteria for a review focused on LULC future prediction.)
